episode.brief: Prepare Relay's public launch. Delegate the responsive product site, three campaign concepts, and an independent claim-and-embargo release review to three parallel workers, then integrate them into one coherent launch identity, one selected campaign master, and a governed release packet. Do not blend the supplied brand systems or invent customer proof.

source.adaptation: Combines two long-form artifact kernels around one original Relay launch packet, then adds an original claim-provenance and embargo-governance stream whose gates must converge with both artifacts.
